thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — I plan to roll a small autoscale tweak to gpu-pool-9 tonight at 22:00 PT. It raises min replicas 2→4 for the promo window. No model bump. @sam @devon can you ack?

sam: Ack. Is this a config-only flip? Any node drain or pod restarts we should expect?

maria: Config-only. infra-api will patch the policy; pods shouldn't be drained. We'll pre-warm by scaling up min and let autoscaler attach.

maria: Policy snippet:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 4
  max_replicas: 12
  target_gpu_util: 0.65
```

maria: Deploy command for reference:
```
infractl apply --pool gpu-pool-9 --policy-file infra/policies/gpu-pool-9-autoscale.yaml --reason "promo-boost-2026-03-17"
```

devon: Rollback plan?

maria: Rollback is single command to reset min back to 2. I'll leave it to devon to execute if needed:
```
infractl set-autoscale --pool gpu-pool-9 --min 2 --sync
```

lee: Smoke checklist so oncall/QA know what to hit:
1) Deploy to staging now (maria has done that).
2) Run quick generator smoke: `curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEV_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | jq -r '.choices[0].text'`
3) Verify per-instance GPU util doesn't spike >95% in Console -> Pools -> gpu-pool-9 -> Metrics
4) Check inference 5xx and 429 spikes in APM for the next 15m

anne: I'm on monitoring rotation tonight, will watch dashboards at 22:00–23:30 PT. Tag me if anything looks off.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy queued — run_id=run_20260317_2200, user=maria

devon: I'll be available at deploy time to validate smoke and run the rollback command if we see 5xxs or sustained OOMs. Ping me in this thread when infractl finishes.

sam: Confirmed code review done for the policy file (PR #3122 reviewed). No objections.

maria: Thanks all. I'll trigger at 22:00 PT, wait 5m for autoscale to stabilize, then call the smoke steps. Will post run_id when it starts. :thumbsup:

devon: Got it — standing by.

anne: noted, will set an alert to page if error rate > 1% for more than 3m.

maria: run started: run_id=run_20260317_2200, started_by=maria

deploy-bot: run_id=run_20260317_2200 completed — status=success, changes_applied=policy_patch

maria: Apply succeeded. Waiting 5m then kicking off smoke now.

lee: Smoke OK on staging, generator output looks normal, no 5xxs. GPU util across new replicas ~60%.

anne: No alerts so far. Monitoring green.

devon: All clear from ops side. No rollback needed. Closing loop.

maria: Great — thanks everyone. Will keep this locked for the promo window. :party:
